goal: Keep the Palmetto Epoxy website, blog connection, lead path, content, search foundation, and security controls healthy after launch.
Publish useful, client-approved content that supports residential and commercial surface-coating decisions in Bluffton and the surrounding Lowcountry.
Use recurring maintenance and reporting to identify broken paths, content opportunities, and technical issues before they become expensive problems.
deliverables: Monthly maintenance plan for the approved Palmetto Epoxy website and blog connection.
Routine hosting, security, dependency, form, analytics, sitemap, robots, structured-content, and performance checks.
Up to one client-approved blog post and one coordinated social-content package per month under the GROWTH scope.
Monthly review of supplied project media, reviews, FAQs, seasonal information, service updates, and citation consistency.
Monthly summary of completed work, open issues, measured signals, and recommended next actions.

description: Monitor hosting, deployment, domain, and SSL health subject to account access.
Review security updates and dependency risks.
Monitor contact forms and primary lead paths.
Review relevant logs and failures and escalate issues that require client or third-party access.
Review page performance and important user paths.
Check sitemap, robots directives, canonical URLs, and structured content.
Review indexed-page and crawl issues when Search Console access is provided.
Make focused updates when an issue is within the approved maintenance scope.
Apply client-supplied updates to services, projects, reviews, contact details, and approved media.
Keep third-party links, social profiles, award references, and business details current.
Review supplied content for unsupported claims before publication.
No content, review, project result, warranty, pricing, or certification is invented when source material is not supplied.
Write up to one new blog post per month from the approved content calendar.
Prepare up to one coordinated social-content package per month.
Use verified claims, approved imagery, and links to relevant services, projects, FAQs, and contact paths.
Review available performance signals when analytics and platform access are provided.
Review consistency of business name, phone, email, website, service categories, service areas, and approved award language.
Identify citation, profile, and internal-link opportunities for Bluffton, Hilton Head, Sun City, Okatie, and Beaufort.
Advertising spend, paid placement, reputation-management campaigns, and directory fees are excluded unless separately approved.

startDate: To be scheduled after website launch or maintenance approval

milestones.milestone: Access, baseline audit, and maintenance priorities
First approved content update and reporting cycle
Technical health, search, analytics, and conversion review
Calendar-based editorial, social, and local-visibility planning

description: The monthly fee was not verified in the available public research and must be completed after package level, access, publishing volume, and client responsibilities are confirmed.
Advertising spend, third-party subscriptions, hosting or domain charges, paid media production, and work outside the listed package are excluded unless approved separately.
Work requiring new features, major redesign, custom integrations, emergency response, or substantial content production will be scoped separately.
